Export joinpoint results

Source: R/export.R
jp_export.Rd

Writes the result tables of a joinpoint fit to delimited text files, one file per table: data and modeled values, APCs, AAPCs, joinpoint locations, model estimates, model selection (criteria, permutation tests, data dependent selection, MADWD and the final selected models with their search limits), coefficient covariances, jump estimates, pairwise and AAPC comparisons, clustering tables, skipped cohorts, the centered covariate design, a supplied covariance matrix and every setting of the run. saveRDS() keeps the complete fitted object.

Usage

jp_export(
  object,
  dir,
  prefix = "joinpoint",
  model = c("all", "final"),
  comparison = NULL,
  sep = ","
)

Arguments

object

A joinpoint or jp_cluster object.

dir

Output directory (created if needed).

prefix

File name prefix.

model

"all" (every fitted model) or "final".

comparison

Optional result of jp_compare() to export with the fit.

sep

Field separator.

Value

The paths of the written files, invisibly.

Examples

tb <- subset(us_mortality, cause == "Tuberculosis")
fit <- joinpoint(tb, year, rate, kmax = 2, ci_method = "parametric")
dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "joinpoint-example")
files <- jp_export(fit, dir)
basename(files)
#> [1] "joinpoint.Data.txt"                  
#> [2] "joinpoint.APCs.txt"                  
#> [3] "joinpoint.AAPCs.txt"                 
#> [4] "joinpoint.Joinpoints.txt"            
#> [5] "joinpoint.Model.Estimates.txt"       
#> [6] "joinpoint.Coefficient.Covariance.txt"
#> [7] "joinpoint.Model.Selection.txt"       
#> [8] "joinpoint.Final.Selected.Model.txt"  
#> [9] "joinpoint.Run.Summary.txt"           
unlink(dir, recursive = TRUE)
